mcp_tools.name: local_first_sync_design
mcp_tools.title: Local-first sync design
mcp_tools.description: Submits a local-first sync design record (local truth and data model, sync protocol, encryption and keys, conflicts and state UI, testing and quality gates) and returns a deterministic LOCAL_FIRST_SYNC_SOUND / LOCAL_FIRST_SYNC_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed per-entity merge-semantics and silent-last-write-wins checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared design; it syncs nothing.

inputSchema.description: The local first sync design manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

entities.description: Declared entities: {name, per_field_merge_semantics_declared, stable_id_declared, is_user_prose, silent_last_write_wins_present}.

personal_data_sync.description: Personal-data sync evidence (gates the encryption checks).

expect.notes: All fields present and valid. Computed ratios: merge_semantics_coverage=1.000000, stable_id_coverage=1.000000. entities_count=1.
